summary.text: Jeanne Renaud Costello is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 6th Worcester District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican John J. Marsi Jr.

paragraphs.text: Renaud Costello advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, she ran for the same seat in 2024 as the Democratic nominee and lost the general election to Marsi, 61.8 percent to 38.0 percent.
Ballotpedia also lists her as an unenrolled write-in candidate in the March 5, 2024 special general election for the district, in which Marsi won.
